accommodation: Grass tent pitches, caravan, campervan and motorhome pitches with hardstanding and electric options, plus seasonal pitches.
suitableFor: Campers, campervan and motorhome surfers, families, dog owners
dogs: Dogs welcome year-round; on-site dog walk.
beachAccess: About a five-minute drive to Saunton Sands; bus stop outside the entrance serves the beach. Braunton within walking distance.
confirmedFeatures: Hot showers, on-site shop, free Wi-Fi, playground, dog walk, food vans
overview: A caravan and camping park between Braunton and Saunton, about five minutes' drive from Saunton Sands and within walking distance of Braunton village. It takes tents, caravans, campervans and motorhomes, with hardstanding and electric pitches.
surfTripFit: A practical, close base for Saunton and Croyde surfers, especially in vans, with a bus to the beach from the gate; no board storage is mentioned.
gaps: Opening season, pitch numbers, parking rules and board/wetsuit facilities not stated.
